name: After the Dust Settles
source:
Jaehrim struggles with nightmares and guilt over the sacrifices of his two childhood friends. As his nightmares mock him and remind him of how he had made their sacrifices ultimately in vain, something deeper lurks just beneath the surface.

[From [url=https://dontouchglazz.itch.io/after-the-dust-settles]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
贾里姆在噩梦中挣扎，并为他两个儿时好友的牺牲而感到内疚。当他的噩梦嘲笑他并提醒他如何最终徒劳地做出牺牲时，一些更深层次的东西潜伏在表面之下。

[来自[url=https://dontouchglazz.itch.io/after-the-dust-settles]Itch.io[/url]]
